title: Finite compatible stage lifts of raw matching families
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone with vertex $C$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ and $Q$ be precoverages on $F(j)$ and $C$. Every transition functor $F(a)$ and cocone functor $V_j$ is continuous for the generated topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Fix $i\in J$ and a set-valued sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $I=\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $A_t=F(t.hom)_sG$. For $b:t\to t'$ give a sheaf map $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^s A_{t'}$ whose composite with the unit $G\to F(t.hom)^s A_t$ equals the unit at $t'$ componentwise as objects of the arrow category of sets. For $t\in I$ let $B_t$ be a presheaf on $C$, with $\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^p B_t$ exhibiting $B_t$ as the left Kan extension of the underlying presheaf of $A_t$ along $V_t^{op}$. Here $V_t=V_{t.right}$, $V_t^p$ is presheaf restriction, and a left Kan extension means that composition with $\beta_t$ bijects maps $B_t\to T$ with maps $A_t\to V_t^p T$ for every presheaf $T$. Let $B:I\to\mathrm{PSh}(C)$ have these objects and satisfy, for all $b:t\to t'$ and $X\in F(t.right)$, $\beta_t(X)B(b)(V_tX)=\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X)$ as objects of $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Set})$.Assume also that the object and arrow cocones of $V$ are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Every $P_j$ has singleton isomorphism covers, covering pullbacks, stability under finite composition and finite base change [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage]. Every covering presieve of $P_j$ has finitely many distinct arrows. Transitions preserve covering presieves and pullbacks along their covering arrows, and their inverse-image functors preserve finite limits. Each $V_j$ preserves covering pullbacks. Fix j in J, X in F(j), a covering presieve R in P_j(X), and a compatible family x of raw sections on R.map(V_j). There exist t in Under(i), W in F(t.right), a covering presieve T in P_t(W), an equality e: V_t(W)=V_j(X), and a compatible family y of A_t sections on T. The arrows V_t(g) followed by the equality transport e, indexed by the set T.uncurry of covering arrows, generate exactly R.map(V_j). For each such g: Z -> W the image of y_g under beta_t(Z) and the colimit coprojection equals x at V_t(g) followed by e. This asserts only a compatible stage lift, not an amalgamation or its uniqueness.

proof.text: Index R by its finite subtype R.uncurry. Use finite simultaneous raw section lifting to obtain sections s at a stage receiving j and i; no compatibility is required for this step.

The cocone equation supplies L followed by M = V_j. Its equality transports intertwine the image of each covering arrow. Apply the given raw compatibility hx on the limit category to the image of each pair of common test arrows at the new stage. The section-image equalities from the preceding step give indexed raw compatibility of s. The mapped indexed presieve is covering by hcover.
Apply finite raw matching refinement to this already represented indexed family. Obtain a further stage with a compatible indexed family s' and prescribed transported raw images.

Transport the covering presieve by the second transition. Prove it is covering using hcover. Composition of the two cocone equations identifies the final target with V_j X. The explicit image_cover_eq helper proves that mapping the uncurried transported presieve and composing with this equality gives exactly R.map V_j. Mathlib Arrows.Compatible.familyOfElements descends the compatible indexed sections through repeated arrows and proves compatibility. Its evaluation lemma identifies the section at each index. Compose the two raw image formulas; finally apply hx along the equality of source objects and the identity to identify these images with x on the final covering arrows. Empty indices and repeated arrows are covered by the same construction.

theorem colimit_site_raw_section_matching_lift
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k), PreservesFiniteLimits
      (sheafPullback (F.map a).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck)]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck (Type u))
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (∀ X : F.obj i,
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X) ≫
                              (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X))))
    (B : Under i ⥤ (V.ptᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u))
    (β : ∀ t : Under i,
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⟶
        (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ B.obj t)
    (hβ : ∀ t : Under i, (B.obj t).IsLeftKanExtension (β t))
    (hβmap : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj t.right),
      Arrow.mk ((β t).app (op X) ≫
        (B.map b).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t' b).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (β t').app (op ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj X))))
    (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X) (hR : R ∈ P j X)
    (x : (R.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor).FamilyOfElements (colimit B))
    (hx : x.Compatible) :
    ∃ (t : Under i) (W : F.obj t.right) (T : Presieve W) (hcoverT : T ∈ P t.right W)
      (e : (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj W = (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X)
      (hT : Presieve.ofArrows
        (fun p : T.uncurry ↦ (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj p.val.1)
        (fun p ↦ (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.map p.val.2 ≫ eqToHom e) =
          R.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor)
      (y : T.FamilyOfElements
        ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj),
      y.Compatible ∧ ∀ p : T.uncurry,
        (colimit.ι B t).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj p.val.1))
          ((β t).app (op p.val.1) (y p.val.2 p.property)) =
        x ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.map p.val.2 ≫ eqToHom e)
          (hT ▸ Presieve.ofArrows.mk p)
